Table 13 lists three Basal and four Late libraries, while the reporting summary excludes one Basal from 13 and Figure 2a states n=3 per group. The included-library mapping remains unresolved. studies.finding: Selected astrocytes showed stimulus-linked glutamate signals sensitive to VGLUT1 deletion; paired fields near recombined astrocytes showed lower LTP.
limitations: LTP measurements used male GFAPCreERT2Slc17a7fl/fltdTomatolsl/lsl mice at postnatal days 35-40 after sparse tamoxifen-induced recombination; slices were recorded with picrotoxin. Neighboring fields, not independent whole-animal groups, were compared.
The separate glutamate-imaging assay used 4-5-month-old mice, virally targeted astrocytes, Gq-DREADD/CNO and synaptic blockers. It is not the same preparation as the LTP assay.

Glutamate detection depends on the sensor, sampled field, stimulus delivery and response thresholds. The source table does not resolve the conflicting total cell counts; no exact in situ response rate is assigned.

Molecular clusters and human transcript-label transfer are observational. Functional findings concern selected mouse astrocytes, not all astrocytes, microglia, oligodendrocytes or a human glial mechanism.
Source-table inspection is not independent reproduction of raw trials, image analysis, statistics or causal specificity.
